technologies.name: Metallic Fusion
technologies.description: By utilizing fusion to create new metals from cheaper materials, our shipyards can produce construction ships at a lower cost. Perhaps in the future this can be applied to more advanced ships as well.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: C.A.T. Algorithms
technologies.description: These sophisticated programs construct and outline build plans concurrently with manufacturing, shortening the time it takes to conceptualize needed assembly details and implement changes or upgrades.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Construction Autobots
technologies.description: Small bots programmed to follow specific ship blueprints to the letter, they are cheap to mass produce and aid in streamlining construction of science ships.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Ablative Plating
technologies.description: Composite materials with reflective properties infused into the metal alloys of science vessels increase their durability for deep space voyages.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Recycled Prefabrication
technologies.description: Prefabricated buildings already allow for rapid colonization so the next logical step is the ability to reuse said materials. By recycling old prefabrications, colonies can construct new buildings at speed.

technologies.name: Composite Plating
technologies.description: The machinery and electronics of a space station are quite delicate and require their hulls to be made of several materials. During construction, composite plating over these materials allows for flexible, yet tough hull infrastructures.

technologies.name: Home Matériel Directive
technologies.description: Arms and equipment doesn't produce itself. Organizational and Operational Directives for the production of minerals for war efforts have proven effective on our Capital.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
Has researched Central Engineering Research Facility

technologies.name: Central Engineering Research Facility
technologies.description: Establishment of a central Engineering facility improves coordination, communication, and leadership of all research efforts in the Capital.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
Has researched Central Engineering Research Facility

technologies.name: Evasion Drives
technologies.description: Special hyper-warp drives designed to activate according to programmed scenarios. When a situation becomes untenable, these drives begin automatic calculations of available hyperlanes, then engage immediately, improving chances for successful escape.

technologies.name: Deep Space Sensors
technologies.description: Improved long-range sensors give survey ships the ability to detail and map a celestial object from light years away, improving the speed at which data is able to be gleaned about survey targets.

technologies.name: Construction Tug Ships
technologies.description: Medium-sized automated ships that can carry great weights as well as construct facilities. When paired with a Construction Ship, they can assist in the building of mining stations at speed.

technologies.name: Research Logistics
technologies.description: Improvements to Research Station organization and construction have increased the rate at which they can be built.

technologies.name: Research Grants
technologies.description: Advancement in the sciences can be costly, especially when it comes to engineering. By allocating funds specifically for research, engineers and designers can iterate without budget concerns. If it isn't broke, it doesn't have enough features yet.

technologies.name: Central Shipyard Complex
technologies.description: The needs of an intergalactic empire's shipbuilding knows no limit. These massive shipyard complexes sprawl across their home sectors, making use of all available materials and supply lines to churn out ships at an astonishing rate.

technologies.name: The Last Wall Doctrine
technologies.description: A stratagem calling back all military soldiers in the system to several strategic points on a world to form an impenetrable line of defence.

technologies.name: Twin-Linked Small Weapon Systems
technologies.description: Each small weapon system on our ships has been retrofitted with an additional gun. This allows them to fire alternatingly and faster without incurring extra heat.

technologies.name: Synchronous Designs
technologies.description: By simplifying and making our corvette designs use all similar parts, costs have been reduced for producing them.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Rapid Erection Protocol
technologies.description: Colonies are important for any spacefaring populace, but constructing, transporting, and settling a new world is a slow challenge. With prefabricated structures and a construction protocol in place, our colonization efforts have managed to streamline the process.

technologies.name: Intelligent Design
technologies.description: Discoveries of ancient and sophisticated civilizations as well as their plans for early intelligent life in the universe has led engineers to break the mold. Thinking outside the box has its merits, especially when avoiding the downfall of those who came before.

technologies.name: Titanium Platform Links
technologies.description: Orbital Defense Platforms can be large and burdensome, often limiting how many can be deployed at once. By linking them with titanium bridges and support structures, all available space can be taken advantage of.

technologies.name: Power Armor
technologies.description: Advancements in exoskeletons and armor materials has resulted in the combination of the two finally being viable. Soldiers at the end of their training are now given a custom fitted power suit. These suits of armor are invulnerable to most small arms fire and vastly improve not just endurance, but stamina and biological resistances of our troops.

technologies.name: Expanded Torpedo Bays
technologies.description: These enlarged storage and firing bays allow ships to launch their full torpedo arsenal with speed and efficiency.

technologies.name: Advanced Torpedo Guidance Systems
technologies.description: Incorporating miniaturized computer management Virtual Intelligences into the engines of torpedos allow far more accurate maneuvering, leading to efficient fuel usage and delivery of torpedo payloads at rapid speeds.

technologies.name: Quad-Linked Medium Weapon Systems
technologies.description: The introduction of twin-linked weapon systems among smaller guns led to additional testing with larger weapons. Due to their larger size, an additional two guns were needed to achieve the same success.

technologies.name: Electromagnetic Field Targeting Systems
technologies.description: By utilizing an EMF targeting computer, our space to ground weaponry can single out population centers with remarkable accuracy.

technologies.name: Streamlined Supply Lines
technologies.description: Manufacture of Destroyer-class ships comes at great cost, both in terms of time and supplies. Therefore, Commercial and Military planners have created a safe and streamlined supply line for our military shipyards, reducing the economical strain.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Determined Propensity Directives
technologies.description: Outside of natural discovery, engineers must constantly explore outside the proverbial box in order to improve established workings or create new ones. Government Directives allow for the organization of these efforts to make for the most efficient paths to discovery.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Simplified Circuitry
technologies.description: Starbases often require complex and expensive circuitry in order to function properly. Discovery of new materials has allowed engineers to construct simpler but no less sophisticated circuit boards and wiring, removing part of the expense.

technologies.name: Fungible Accounting
technologies.description: Never underestimate the power of moving money. Allocating finances where they're most needed is especially helpful when constructing expensive, but necessary starbase modules.

technologies.name: Magnetohydrodynamic Accelerators
technologies.description: Advanced magnetohydrodynamic accelerators are fitted on our large weapon systems vastly reducing heat generated while simultaneously greatly increasing their maximum power.

technologies.name: Metal Processing Dockyards
technologies.description: These facilities now come standard with shipyards, increasing the speed at which valuable metals can be processed, reprocessed and distributed to needed cruisers.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Nova-class Hyperdrive Upgrade
technologies.description: These hyperdrive upgrades combine two different schools of intergalactic travel. Fusing warp technology with an advanced hyperdrive improves interstellar travel by a magnitude comparable to previous drives.

technologies.name: Sub-Zero Cooling Regulators
technologies.description: These highly advanced cryo-fusion cooling systems are capable of reducing massive heat output of weapons systems to sub-zero temperatures in moments. Battle testing indicates a substantial increase to our firing rates with this technology.

technologies.name: Retrofit Station
technologies.description: This orbital complex dedicates itself to upgrading any fleet in-system, reducing the need for expensive and wasteful manual upgrades.

technologies.name: Battleship Drydock
technologies.description: Within all shipyard complexes lies a well-equipped drydock intended only for the use of battleships. Assembled for the sole purpose of maintaining, constructing, and upgrading the Battleship-class dreadnaughts in the fleet, they reduce overall costs significantly.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Ergonomic Architecture
technologies.description: Building form is sometimes just as important as building efficiently. By shifting design focus of our buildings to more ergonomical shapes, we can fit more in any given space.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Transformative Materials
technologies.description: The only thing better than recycling is the ability for materials to transform. By applying terraforming techniques to our constructive materials themselves, builders can utilize them for almost anything needed.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Precursor Designworks
technologies.description: Examining the works of those who came before has lead to significant advances in the planning and execution of megastructure construction.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Autowork Factories
technologies.description: Megastructures are suitably colossal and with that comes the ability to house appropriately sized autonomous factories within them. These giant facilities churn out and process materials at an exponential rate.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Integrated Engineering Labs
technologies.description: Building a megastructure is an engineering feat all its own. By incorporating large engineering labs into them, our engineers can more easily maintain and study these massive creations.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Biosynthetic Metallurgy
technologies.description: Combining biology with synthetic materials is no simple process. With a bit of ingenuity and a lot of unseemly results, we have been able to apply the proper process to certain metals. Fusing living organisms compatible with these materials gives them increased durability as well as self-regenerative properties, reducing maintenance costs.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Flexiplast Alloy
technologies.description: A flexible and durable metal that utilizes some of the cheaper materials to produce. While not suitable for warfare, civilian ships can be made much more affordable.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

unlocks.name: Science Ship Hyper Jump Charge Time -50%

modifiers.name: Science Ship Hyper Jump Charge Time

technologies.name: Science Bays
technologies.description: Shipyards outfitted with dedicated Science, Research & Development Bays allow for the production of scientific vessels at an increased rate while still allowing for ample production of military vessels.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Multi-Dimensional Rangefinding
technologies.description: New targeting algorithms that are far more efficient in calculating trajectories within 3-dimensional space.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Small Weapon Capacitors
technologies.description: High-power capacitors integrated in the small weapon systems of our ships allow them to charge beyond their operational limits.

technologies.name: Automated Recycle Rates
technologies.description: Improved programs allow for the automation of our weapons-fire recycle systems. This increases the efficiency of our point defence weapons, enabling them to fire more rapidly.

technologies.name: Bio-Electric Rounds
technologies.description: Small feedback chips implanted in special ordnance release a shock of over five hundred thousand volts through the systems of any amoeba it impacts, spreading through their cellular systems like wildfire.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Acidic Bio-Material
technologies.description: Incorporating this material into our secondary armaments allows for them to burn through crystalline hulls with ease.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Anti-Mining
technologies.description: Deconstructing a mining drone has led to the development of advanced lasers designed to cut through the hulls commonly used by those ships.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Destabilization Fields
technologies.description: Microparticles are released in an area that, when passed through by a energy-cloud, destabilizes their cores.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Mass Shadow Reactor
technologies.description: A giant reactor complex that uses miniature singularities to generate gravity, then converts it into usable energy.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
Has researched Central Engineering Research Facility

technologies.name: Singularity Lab
technologies.description: The ability to generate singularities in a contained unit aids in the study of gravimetric patterns and its influence on the surrounding environment.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
Has researched Central Engineering Research Facility

technologies.name: Anti-Radiation Insulators
technologies.description: Dual layers of fabric interwoven with polyethylene and PVC-based polymer infused into hull plating increases their efficiency in protecting stations frequently orbiting harmful environments.

technologies.name: Administrative Data Library
technologies.description: Installing a data library in all every personal data slate allows for the quick and easy accessing of needed information. Wise leaders will often find themselves studying on it.

technologies.name: Mass Locking
technologies.description: Advanced FTL sensors allow for a much stronger mass-lock on the target sun vastly increasing our ability to travers the FTL current.

technologies.name: Integrated Laboratories
technologies.description: Small physics labs integrated with most facilities improve the ability to research physics projects. These labs are linked directly to the communications network, providing scientists with the ability to share their finds rapidly.

technologies.name: Cryo-Fusion Fire Control System
technologies.description: Cryo-fusion systems regulate the heat buildup of our medium weapons batteries, allowing them to fire higher capacity loads before burning out.

technologies.name: Bulwark Plating
technologies.description: Divots and minor hull fortifications spread across a defense platform help increase their resistance to multiple types of weapons fire. Integrating miniature shield generators at each point prevents colossal damage from being incurred.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Current stabilization
technologies.description: Advancements in our engine design reduces turbulence in the FTL conduits.

technologies.name: Enhanced Physics Intelligence
technologies.description: This AI has been designed from the ground up as a scientific processor, capable of sifting through and analyzing thousands of physics experiments in seconds. Also equipped with a Social Interface Chip, the EPI can interact with researchers on a personal level, helping improve performance.

technologies.name: Hull Vulnerabilities
technologies.description: Experience from ship to ship combat has taught our admirals to spot vulnerable points in a ship's hull with great accuracy.

technologies.name: Anti-Matter Clouds
technologies.description: Heavily shielded weapon ports allow for the release of concentrated bursts of anti-matter, clearing the way for any fire.

technologies.name: Advanced Gravimetric Sensors
technologies.description: Utilizing an increased understanding of gravitic properties in our sensor systems provides our defense platforms the ability to coordinate their orbits and reduce the risk of collision, allowing more to be fielded at a time.

technologies.name: Armor Weakpoints
technologies.description: By definition, armor is an added defensive layer, and thus must always have weak points.

technologies.name: Focused Fire Protocols
technologies.description: Combat protocols designed to concentrate fire on weak points in enemy ship armor.

technologies.name: Ionised Charges
technologies.description: Negative-ion pulses are charged into our weapon systems which then fire towards their targets, destabilizing and disrupting shield barriers.

technologies.name: Disruptor Charges
technologies.description: Miniaturized negative-ion pulses are charged around a discharge, giving it a good chance of penetrating a shield and allowing it to hit its target uninterrupted.

technologies.name: Multi-Warheads
technologies.description: Several warheads are stacked tightly together and are released just before impact to create multiple points of impact.

technologies.name: Micro Fusion Batteries
technologies.description: Miniaturization of fusion reactor technology into belt-mounted generators allows for more efficient energy consumption among fielded troops.

technologies.name: Condensed Warp Bubble
technologies.description: A smaller warp bubble around our vessales greatly speed up are ability to travel through the FTL conduits.

technologies.name: Standardized Supercomputers
technologies.description: Laboratories with built-in supercomputers have proven to increase the efficiency of staff across our research division. With information readily available at any given moment and the analyzation capabilities of an Enhanced Physics Intelligence, no laboratory is complete without one.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Negative-Mass Core
technologies.description: A second energy core designed to produce a negative-energy field vastly speeds up our FTL travel by reducing the energy needed to accellerate.

technologies.name: Overcharged Capacitors
technologies.description: Harnessing the formerly unfathomable power of dark matter into our weapon reactors allows our heaviest weapons to inflict catastrophic damage.

technologies.name: Retractable Orbital Plating
technologies.description: Small stations situated just below orbit at key points over a world can be activated at a moments notice to spread a titanium plate shell connecting each station over important areas and cities. While not invulnerable, it slows the inexorable destruction posed by orbital bombardment until reinforcements can arrive.

technologies.name: Solarite Infused Alloy
technologies.description: The complicated process of constructing a megastructure often leads to inspiration amongst engineering crews. Discovery of solarite, a special metallic material that has superconductive and solar energy absorbing properties make for a great constructive alloy. Incorporating this metal into a megastructure will improve its capacity to generate energy.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Quasar Research Facility
technologies.description: Solving the mystery of quasars is now within reach. Special massive facilities only capable of being built within megastructures allows research to be conducted from an artificial miniature quasar. The extreme luminosity and power generated by quasars could lead to leaps in physics advancements.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Correlative Data Systems
technologies.description: Connecting all of a science ships working parts and electronics is a work of art. Thankfully, ship engineers are up to the task.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: AgriCorps Headquarters
technologies.description: The centralization of agriculture programs and organization has shown a significant increase in capital food production.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
Has researched Central Engineering Research Facility

technologies.name: Quid Pro Quo
technologies.description: Core world scientists have been sufficiently motivated with new research grants, improving efficiency.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
Has researched Central Engineering Research Facility

technologies.name: Quantum Data Network
technologies.description: Storing knowledge is just as important as finding it. This upgraded network utilizes faster than light data streams with a centralized data source to house all known information from surveyors. Quick access to this is provided at a glance for those seeking new developments in the unknown.

technologies.name: Aberration Academies
technologies.description: Exploration of space can be a daunting task, but one that provides the curious with a never-ending adventure of peculiar discoveries. Academies teaching students the finer aspects of anomaly research prepares them for the worst and best of their new profession.

technologies.name: Regenerative Cellular Reconstruction
technologies.description: By resequencing DNA and splicing it with strands taken from a highly regenerative cell sample, we can live for much longer before cellular degradation begins to erode function.

technologies.name: Reusable Materials
technologies.description: Significant improvements in recycling technology has given our engineers the ability to incorporate and breakdown reusable materials and parts in most construction.

technologies.name: Outer District Stockpiles
technologies.description: By storing our excess resources in stockpiles in our outer districts we can construct new ajacent districts at a reduced cost.

technologies.name: Defined Hierarchy
technologies.description: The bigger an empire gets, the more difficult it can be to keep track of rank. With a regimented and defined hierarchy, everyone knows who to answer to.

technologies.name: Cultural Studies
technologies.description: All research curriculum has been expanded with additional cultural anecdotes from all known sources in the galaxy, improving general knowledge of galactic culture.

technologies.name: Adaptive Virtual Intelligence
technologies.description: Equipping vessels with a virtual intelligence capable of adapting to most situations is tantamount to AI function, but slightly safer due to the lack of personality matrices.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Mining Administrations
technologies.description: Industry and mining are necessary evils in order to continue providing for an ever-expanding civilization. The construction and maintenance of mining facilities is a drain on any government, and the formation of mining administrations has lessened the burden.

technologies.name: Efficient Research Planning
technologies.description: Planning out research outposts has become a nececity as resources are often needed on mining stations and defensive stations first. Planning which research station gets constructed next is vital to keep our research going.

technologies.name: Automated Colony Ship Systems
technologies.description: By automating most functions of colony ships, less staff need to be instructed and employed while cost-prohibitive systems can be replaced with cheaper alternatives.

technologies.name: Colonial Shipyards
technologies.description: Any civilization seeking to colonize the stars knows the use of having specified shipyards for the purpose. Dedicating supply routes and providing detailed plans additionaly simply the assembly process.

technologies.name: Cultural Tactics
technologies.description: Studying enemy psychology and cultural bias has been a point of contention amongst strategists for some time. An admiral in our navy has convinced the rest of the Admiralty the value of understanding your opponents every reason to make a choice, improving our success rate at identifying patterns and shutting down pirates' often erratic behaviours.

technologies.name: Planetoid Sweepers
technologies.description: Employing colossal automated rovers that clear away obstructions on a massive scale has improved our ability to perfect a planet's suitability for development.

technologies.name: Personal Thermoregulation Units
technologies.description: A small device that projects a field of cold air around the user. Useful in areas with extreme heat.

technologies.name: Moisture Farms
technologies.description: Tall tree-like structures that slowly spin their metallic leaves around capturing moisture from the air.

technologies.name: Hydrogeneration
technologies.description: Simply creating water out of nothing is an impossibility. Creating water out of rock and sand however, is a draining process, but a possible one.

details.text: Is planet class is Savanna World

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
Has researched By Land Or Sea

technologies.name: Anti-Disease Symbiotes
technologies.description: The most dangerous aspect of tropical habitation is often the diseases introduced by such systems. With these engineered symbiotes, preventing and fighting said concerns is much easier.

details.text: Is planet class is Tropical World

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: By Land Or Sea
technologies.description: In order to effectively colonize continents, we must be equally suited to both land and sea. Converting land-based technology to work in a hydrosphere is a solid first step.

details.text: Is planet class is Continental World

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
Has researched By Land Or Sea

technologies.name: Aquatic Habitats
technologies.description: Constructing underwater municipalities utilizing water resistant alloys improves ocean world habitability.

details.text: Is planet class is Ocean World

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Precipitation Generators
technologies.description: Significant dry seasons and arid land pose significant issues. High-maintenance moisture generators convert the near frozen air into usable water.

details.text: Is planet class is Tundra World

technologies.name: Fusion Heat Reactors
technologies.description: The benefit of fusion technology applies to more than just power. By utilizing the heat generated by such devices, entire settlements can be kept warm, despite inhospitable temperatures.

details.text: Is planet class is Arctic World

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Bedrock Settlements
technologies.description: Engineers have perfected the art of constructing settlements both without and within mountain ranges.

technologies.name: Galactic Social Center
technologies.description: A large museum-like structure incorporating cultural artifacts and treatises from across the galaxy. These massive repositories help to expand understanding and the broadening of societal thought.

technologies.name: Demagogue's Fervor
technologies.description: Demagogues are often painted in a poor light, though there is no questioning their effectiveness in convincing the population to act in times of need.

technologies.name: Flash Learning
technologies.description: Troops throughout their training process are connected to vast computer systems that employ visual and auditory stimulants in conjunction with neural data transmissions to rapidly teach non-physical regimens.

technologies.name: Hardened Conditioning
technologies.description: Field training exercises have shown a remarkable increase in morale amongst troops put through rigorous conditioning exercises.

technologies.name: Focus Fire Initiative
technologies.description: Troops have been instructed on the merits of focusing their fire onto a singular, critical target, improving their destructive coordination.

technologies.name: Wartime Industry
technologies.description: Policies that dictate both resource consumption as well as directed workforces improve utilization of said resources during wartime.

technologies.name: Investigative Bureau
technologies.description: An organized government force dedicated to rooting out corruption within the empire, no matter how far across the galaxy.

technologies.name: Supply Ships
technologies.description: Colony ships escorted by smaller prefabricated supply ships reduces the amount of time needed to equip a new colony.

technologies.name: Commerce Hyperlanes
technologies.description: Providing offices for trading companies can drastically improve our empires trade capability. Being in close proximity to each other they can establish safe trade routes. Their trade ships can travel farther and faster with little added risk.

technologies.name: Privateers
technologies.description: Commercial incentives have proven to be remarkably effective in reducing the danger of trade routes being plundered.

technologies.name: Warp Processing
technologies.description: Computational advancements in AI technology combined with experimental microwarp technology allow for AI's to now process and make millions of decisions in less than a microsecond.

technologies.name: Ruthless Reputations
technologies.description: Pirates often enough respect authority once it's slammed into their faces. By taking the time and spreading the information of what happens to pirates caught by our fleets, they are less enthusiastic about their activities.

technologies.name: Demagogue Training
technologies.description: Educating leaders in the art of speaking and persuasion improves their ability to convince others of their positions, cementing them in the minds of the people.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Eloquent Calumniating
technologies.description: Diplomacy is often the art of being able to bring people together, but sometimes it is more beneficial to be feared. Diplomats trained in psychology can put it to use when undermining the enemy.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Settlement AI
technologies.description: An intricate cognitive AI that is designed to simplify construction of settlements. By analyzing the needs of the populace, the AI determines a priority list for construction in rapid succession.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Abrassive Diplomacy
technologies.description: Putting up a harsh and strict diplomatic front might not be the kindest way to hold talks, but it sure as blorg makes us heard.

technologies.name: Irrefutable Ultimatums
technologies.description: Once dominance has been displayed, issuing an ultimatum becomes less a matter of potential refusal and more akin to inevitable acquiescence.

technologies.name: Cutthroat Confederation
technologies.description: Normally integrating one empire into another is a diplomatically delicate process. By ignoring traditional protocols and employing annexation directives, an empire can be integrated in a significantly shorter period of time.

technologies.name: Convincing Possessive Persuasion
technologies.description: Some diplomats are exceedingly good at convincing the galaxy that possession is 9/10ths of the law.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Civic Revelations
technologies.description: With the continued exploration and incredible encounters of space, our scientists have continued to expand their knowledge of society and how it evolves in unique ways.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Emigration Accounts
technologies.description: Seperate imigration funds and budgets provides a faster way of financing resettlement endeavors.

technologies.name: Cultural Exchange Posts
technologies.description: Small, interstellar facilities that are equipped to house a modest amount of beings as well as outfitted with materials and items of cultural significance. Designed with the intention of broadening cultural awareness and acceptance, these facilities help reduce the contentious nature of sharing borders.

technologies.name: Transformative Curriculum
technologies.description: Specific programs and educational opportunities in terraforming allow scientists to not just specialize in this difficult task, but to also maintain their expertise and knowledge of techniques.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Centralized Agency
technologies.description: A giant government facility that is responsible for managing the various agencies throughout the empire. With vast communication networks and data libraries, the potential for misplaced governance is heavily minimized.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Adaptable Engineering
technologies.description: Designing shelters and outposts that are capable of functioning on a variety of worlds assists greatly when dealing with the inhospitable.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Reexamination Protocols
technologies.description: While innovation is an ever-changing process, sometimes it's beneficial to look to what led us down a path less traveled. Researching our own designs and how we came to the conclusions necessary to build them provides great strides in future studies and discovery.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk

technologies.name: Black Budgets
technologies.description: Classifying all reports and splitting up production of each section of a megastructure reduces the likelihood of political elements discovering its existence.

narration.text: Has the Technological Ascendancy ascension perk
